description.zh:
用户登录云电脑后是否具有管理员权限。

> 该功能处于定向邀测中，暂不对外开放。
description.en:
Specifies whether a user has administrative permissions after logging on to the cloud computer.

> This feature is in invitational preview and is not available to the public.

description.zh: 是否开启防截屏功能。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the anti-screenshot feature.

description.zh: 客户端IP白名单列表。设置后，仅白名单网段内的IP地址可访问云电脑。
description.en: The client IP address whitelist. After you configure this parameter, only IP addresses in the whitelist can access the cloud computer.

description.zh: 客户端访问IP地址段。格式为CIDR格式的IPv4地址段。
description.en: The client IP address CIDR block. The value is an IPv4 CIDR block.

description.zh: 客户端IP白名单的描述信息。
description.en: The description of the client IP address whitelist.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则列表。
description.en: The list of security group rules.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的对象，CIDR格式的IPv4地址段。
description.en: The object of the security group rule. The value is an IPv4 CIDR block.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的描述信息。
description.en: The description of the security group rule.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的协议类型。
description.en: The protocol type of the security group rule.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的授权策略。
description.en: The authorization policy of the security group rule.

description.zh:
安全组管控规则的端口范围。由协议（IpProtocol）的取值确定端口的取值范围：

- TCP协议或者UDP协议：端口取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（\/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1\/200。
- ICMP协议：端口为-1\/-1。
- GRE协议：端口为-1\/-1。
- IpProtocol取值为all：端口为-1\/-1。

典型应用的常用端口请参见[常用端口](~~40724~~)。
description.en:
The port range of the security group rule. The value of this parameter depends on the value of the \`IpProtocol\` parameter.

- If \`IpProtocol\` is set to TCP or UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the end port. For example: 1/200.

- If \`IpProtocol\` is set to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

- If \`IpProtocol\` is set to GRE, the port range is -1/-1.

- If \`IpProtocol\` is set to all, the port range is -1/-1.

For more information about common ports, see [Common ports](~~40724~~).

description.zh:
安全组管控规则的优先级。数字越小，代表优先级越高。    
取值范围：1~60。    
默认值：1。
description.en:
The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.
Valid values: 1 to 60.
Default value: 1.

description.zh: 安全组管控规则的规则方向。
description.en: The direction of the security group rule.

description.zh: 是否开启本地摄像头重定向。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable local camera redirection.

description.zh: 登录方式管控规则列表。用于控制可通过哪些客户端访问云电脑。
description.en: The list of logon method control rules. These rules control which clients can be used to access the cloud computer.

description.zh:
登录方式管控，设置客户端类型。

> 如果不设置`ClientType`相关参数，则默认允许所有类型的客户端登录云电脑。
description.en:
Logon method control. Specifies the client type.

> If you do not configure the `ClientType` parameters, all types of clients are allowed to log on to the cloud computer by default.

description.zh:
登录方式管控，设置是否允许使用某一类型的客户端登录云电脑。

> 如果不设置`ClientType`相关参数，则默认允许所有类型的客户端登录云电脑。
description.en:
Logon method control. Specifies whether to allow a specific type of client to log on to the cloud computer.

> If you do not configure the `ClientType` parameters, all types of clients are allowed to log on to the cloud computer by default.

description.zh: 剪贴板权限。
description.en: The clipboard permission.

description.zh: 设备重定向规则列表。
description.en: The list of device redirection rules.

description.zh: 外设类型。
description.en: The peripheral type.

description.zh: 重定向类型。
description.en: The redirection type.

description.zh: 自定义外设规则列表。
description.en: The list of custom peripheral rules.

description.zh: 设备名称。
description.en: The device name.

description.zh: 产品ID。
description.en: The product ID (PID).

description.zh: 外设类型。
description.en: The peripheral type.

description.zh: 生产厂商ID。参见[Valid USB Vendor IDs (VIDs)](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf)。
description.en: The vendor ID (VID). For more information, see [Valid USB Vendor IDs (VIDs)](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf).

description.zh: 链接优化指令。
description.en: The link optimization instruction.

description.zh: 重定向类型。
description.en: The redirection type.

description.zh: 访问域名权限管控。域名支持通配符（\*），多个域名之间以半角逗号隔开。
description.en: The policy for controlling access to domain names. You can use a wildcard character (\*). Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

description.zh: 域名解析策略详情。
description.en: The details of the domain name resolution policy.

description.zh: 策略描述。
description.en: The policy description.

description.zh: 域名。
description.en: The domain name.

description.zh: 解析策略。
description.en: The resolution policy.

description.zh: 域名解析策略类型。
description.en: The type of the domain name resolution policy.

description.zh: 用户申请管理员协助开关。
description.en: Specifies whether to allow end users to request assistance from administrators.

description.zh: 用户之间流协同开关。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable stream collaboration between users.

description.zh: 是否为图形型规格云电脑开启画质策略。对云电脑性能和使用体验要求较高时，例如专业设计场景下，建议开启该策略。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the image quality policy for graphics cloud computers. Enable this policy for scenarios that require high performance and user experience, such as professional design.

description.zh:
Web客户端访问策略。

> 推荐您使用`ClientType`相关参数统一管控登录方式。
description.en:
The policy for access from web clients.

> Use the `ClientType` parameters to manage logon methods.

description.zh: Web客户端文传输策略。
description.en: The file transfer policy for web clients.

description.zh: 网络通信协议。
description.en: The network communication protocol.

description.zh: 本地磁盘映射权限。
description.en: The local disk mapping permission.

description.zh: 云电脑由于客观原因造成断开连接的最大连接重试时间。取值范围：30\~7200，单位：秒。
description.en: The maximum amount of time to retry the connection if the cloud computer is disconnected due to an unexpected event. Valid values: 30 to 7200. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 策略名称。
description.en: The policy name.

description.zh:
是否开启网络重定向。

> 该功能处于定向邀测中，暂不对外开放。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable network redirection.

> This feature is in invitational preview and is not available to the public.

description.zh:
云电脑抢占策略。

> 为保证正在使用云电脑的终端用户的操作体验和数据安全，暂不允许多个用户之间互相抢占，即该配置默认为`off`，且不可修改。
description.en:
The preemption policy.

> To ensure the user experience and data security of the end users who are using cloud computers, mutual preemption among multiple users is not allowed. This parameter is set to `off` by default and cannot be changed.

description.zh:
允许抢占云电脑的一组用户的用户名，最多可以设置5个。
> 为保证正在使用云电脑的终端用户的操作体验和数据安全，暂不允许多个用户之间互相抢占。
description.en:
The usernames of the users that are allowed to preempt the cloud computer. You can specify up to five usernames.

> To ensure the user experience and data security of the end users who are using cloud computers, mutual preemption among multiple users is not allowed.

description.zh: 打印机重定向策略。
description.en: The printer redirection policy.

description.zh: 是否开启自定义录屏。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable custom screen recording.

description.zh: 自定义录屏的文件过期时间，默认30天。
description.en: The expiration time of custom recording files. The default value is 30. Unit: days.

description.zh: 是否开启录屏。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable screen recording.

description.zh: 录制云电脑声音的选项。
description.en: The option to record audio from the cloud computer.

description.zh: 录屏文件阅览时长，单位为分钟。录制文件会根据您设置的时长自动切分并上传至存储空间，文件达到300MB时优先滚动更新。
description.en: The duration for viewing the recording file. Unit: minutes. The recording file is automatically split based on the specified duration and uploaded to a bucket. If a file reaches 300 MB, it is rolled over first.

description.zh: 录屏结束时间，取值：HH:MM:SS。只有`Recording`取值是`PERIOD`时，该返回值有实际意义。
description.en: The time when screen recording ends. The value is in the HH:MM:SS format. This parameter is valid only when \`Recording\` is set to \`PERIOD\`.

description.zh: 录屏文件的保留时间。取值范围为1\~180天。
description.en: The retention period of the recording file. Valid values: 1 to 180. Unit: days.

description.zh: 录屏帧率。单位：FPS（帧/秒）。
description.en: The frame rate for screen recording. Unit: frames per second (fps).

description.zh: 录屏开始时间，取值：HH:MM:SS。只有`Recording`取值是`PERIOD`时，该返回值有实际意义。
description.en: The time when screen recording starts. The value is in the HH:MM:SS format. This parameter is valid only when \`Recording\` is set to \`PERIOD\`.

description.zh: 录屏客户端消息通知功能。
description.en: The feature that sends notifications to the client when screen recording is in progress.

description.zh: 录屏客户端通知内容。默认无需填写。
description.en: The content of the notification that is sent to the client when screen recording is in progress. You do not need to specify this parameter.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. Call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to obtain the list of regions that support WUYING Workspace.

description.zh: 远程协助时的键鼠控制权限。
description.en: The keyboard and mouse control permissions for remote assistance.

description.zh: 策略的生效范围。
description.en: The scope of the policy.

description.zh: `Scope`取值为`IP`的时候填写。当`Scope`为`IP`时生效，否则不生效。
description.en: This parameter is required when `Scope` is set to `IP`. It takes effect only when `Scope` is set to `IP`.

description.zh: USB重定向。
description.en: USB redirection.

description.zh: USB重定向规则。
description.en: The USB redirection rules.

description.zh: 规则描述。
description.en: The rule description.

description.zh: 设备类别，当`usbRuleType`为1的时候需要填写。参见[Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes)。
description.en: The device class. This parameter is required when `usbRuleType` is set to 1. For more information, see [Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes).

description.zh: 设备子类别，当`usbRuleType`为1的时候需要填写。参见[Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes)。
description.en: The device subclass. This parameter is required when `usbRuleType` is set to 1. For more information, see [Defined Class Codes](https://www.usb.org/defined-class-codes).

description.zh: 产品ID。
description.en: The product ID (PID).

description.zh: USB重定向类型。
description.en: The USB redirection type.

description.zh: USB重定向规则类型。
description.en: The USB redirection rule type.

description.zh: 生产厂商ID。参见[Valid USB Vendor IDs (VIDs)](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf)。
description.en: The vendor ID (VID). For more information, see [Valid USB Vendor IDs (VIDs)](https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/vendor_ids032322.pdf_1.pdf).

description.zh: 多媒体重定向。
description.en: Multimedia redirection.

description.zh: 图像显示质量策略。
description.en: The image display quality policy.

description.zh: 水印。
description.en: The watermark feature.

description.zh: 盲水印防拍照功能。
description.en: The anti-screen-recording feature for invisible watermarks.

description.zh: 水印字体颜色。 取值范围： 0\~16777215。
description.en: The font color of the watermark. Valid values: 0 to 16777215.

description.zh: 水印倾斜度。取值范围：-10\~-30 。
description.en: The rotation angle of the watermark. Valid values: -10 to -30.

description.zh: 水印字体大小。 取值范围：10\~20。
description.en: The font size of the watermark. Valid values: 10 to 20.

description.zh: 水印字体样式。
description.en: The font style of the watermark.

description.zh: 盲水印增强功能。
description.en: The enhanced feature for invisible watermarks.

description.zh:
水印行数。

> 此参数暂未开放使用。
description.en:
The number of watermark rows.

> This parameter is not yet available.

description.zh: 盲水印安全优先规则。
description.en: The security priority rule for invisible watermarks.

description.zh: 水印显示的深浅程度。
description.en: The transparency of the watermark.

description.zh: 水印不透明度，值越大，透明度越小。 取值范围： 10\~100。
description.en: The opacity of the watermark. A larger value indicates lower transparency. Valid values: 10 to 100.

description.zh:
水印类型。最多可以选择3个类型，用半角逗号隔开。

> 若传入`custom`，则必须同时通过参数`WatermarkCustomText`传入自定义文本的内容。
description.en:
The type of watermark. You can specify up to three types. Separate multiple types with commas (,).

> If you set this parameter to `custom`, you must also specify the `WatermarkCustomText` parameter.

description.zh:
通过桌面端（包括Windows客户端和macOS客户端）连接云电脑时，是否在云电脑悬浮球内提供无影AI助手功能入口。

> 仅适用于V7.7或更高版本的桌面端。
description.en:
When you connect to a cloud computer from a desktop client (including a Windows client and a macOS client), specifies whether to display the entry for the WUYING AI assistant in the floating ball on the cloud computer.

> This feature is available only for desktop clients of V7.7 or later.

descriptions.zh: 云电脑策略是一组规则的集合，主要包含云电脑性能和安全方面的配置，例如磁盘映射、USB重定向、水印等基础策略，以及DNS管控等规则。更多信息，请参见[策略概述](~~189345~~)。
descriptions.en: A cloud computer policy is a set of rules for performance and security. These rules configure features such as local disk mapping, USB redirection, watermarks, and DNS control. For more information, see [Policy overview](~~189345~~).
